title: 夕闇通り探検隊
sources: The harness alone, from the game's disc on pcsx_rearmed (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The disc and snaps were studied outside it

Found in play: a scene's script lies whole in work RAM in codes of the scene's own (a 16-bit code a character), found by find_relative on a row read off a picture; the page shown is counted, a scene's and a talk's counters apart
The game draws a page's characters, in order, into a cache of cells in video memory, which the script reads each by its picture
The dictionary: 156 pictures (a bit a pixel, since a talk shades a character otherwise; a space is a cell of its own, read by the script), each a scene's code beside its cell and the page's picture
Played from power-on through the opening, a talk from the notebook, and the talk a walk in the woods brings, with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 35 of 35 pictures, over 3 scenes (23, 11 and 1)

Known limit: the talk a walk brings keeps no count of its page; the script takes the longest run of one or two rows of the scene's script that fits the cache, and leaves out the cache as it stood when such a talk came up
notes: Read by the script games/ps1/SLPS-02274.lua: the subtitle on screen, from the scene's script and the pictures of its characters in video memory, said once the page stands. Not read: menus (the notebook's captions among them). A character not met in play comes out as U+FFFD.
